title: 2568. Minimum Impossible OR

examples.explanation: 1 and 2 are already present in the array. We know that 3 is expressible, since nums[0] | nums[1] = 2 | 1 = 3. Since 4 is not expressible, we return 4.
We can show that 1 is the smallest number that is not expressible.
